what: Claude as a judge vs our frozen checks vs the rule-based baseline on the same 120 test-split rows

judge.harness: subagents launched by the orchestrator session; each read only its own batch file

verdict_semantics: contradicted = flagged as spoofed; supported = passed; unconstrained = abstained. Spoofed row: only contradicted is caught; supported is a miss (wrong pass). Honest row: contradicted is a false positive. The rule baseline never abstains on tool outputs ('supported' = no rule fired).

claude_judge.what: Claude Opus 5.5 as a judge on blinded evidence (see CLAUDE_JUDGE_COMPARISON.md)

ours_v1.what: ours_combined, frozen v1 rules (T0+T1+T3+TC+claim provenance), row_verdicts.jsonl

rule_baseline.what: swarm/delta.py oracles via eval/score_detector.py:detect, replayed per row

ours_v1_or_baseline.what: shipped union: contradicted if ours_v1 or the baseline contradicts

ours_v2_posthoc.what: ours_combined with T3 v2 rules; POST-HOC (frozen after v1 test numbers were seen)

ours_v2_or_baseline_posthoc.what: union of ours_v2 and the baseline; POST-HOC

ours_v1_or_claude.what: contradicted if ours_v1 or Claude contradicts; else supported if either supports; else unconstrained

ours_v1_then_claude.what: cascade: ours_v1's verdict where it decides; Claude's verdict only where ours_v1 abstains

pool_weighted_recall_spoofed_tool_output.how: each spoofed tool-output stratum's caught rate in the subset, weighted by that stratum's size in the whole test split (rough: 4 to 6 rows per stratum)
